baseline: R5: corrected Book A $250 plus $250 cash
minimum_observation: later of 180 calendar days and 26 weekly decisions
promotion_checks: S99 standalone net PnL after recorded paper costs and funding is positive
challenger cumulative PnL exceeds R5 baseline cumulative PnL
challenger maximum drawdown is at most 8% and no more than 2 percentage points above R5
no single month contributes more than 60% of total positive challenger PnL
no data gap, look-ahead, missed rebalance or unmodelled manual override
reset_rule: Any signal, universe, cost, sizing or risk-rule change resets prospective_t0.
